customfield_10020.name: Sprint 6
customfield_10020.goal:
Sprint Goal

Objective – Sprint Goal
Continue building the Torre de Controle (Control Tower) for Middle Mile: add the KPI header so operation health is visible at a glance (trips, in-route, delayed, Act Now, SLA, cost/km), formalize how operators resolve alerts with structured, auditable reasons, and roll out the finalized UI layout across the Control Tower's core screens. The real-time Act Now alerts panel carried over from Sprint 5 is now blocked and needs to be unblocked to avoid slipping a second sprint.

Product and UX/UI

FE layout updates on the Control Tower Main Page (OE-239), Act Now (OE-240) and Trip Detail (OE-241), per finalized Figma — To Do
Evaluation: unify the basic-company "comment" modal with the incidences modal (OE-247) — In Progress

Main Deliveries

Control Tower KPI header — Backend (OE-273) and Frontend (OE-232) — To Do
Act Now — structured tratativa (resolution) reasons, operator↔driver (OE-220) + backend persistence (OE-279) — To Do

Progress (carried over from Sprint 5)

Persist/display destination ETA via price_detail, owned by INF (OE-203) — In Progress
Act Now panel — real-time alert updates via session channels (OE-202) — Blocked ⚠️

Must Be Completed This Sprint

Unblock and ship the Act Now real-time alerts panel (OE-202)
ETA persistence via price_detail (OE-203)
KPI header, backend + frontend (OE-273, OE-232)

Also In This Sprint (maintenance / tech debt)
Reserved-points tech support (OE-290) and Import Edit Address UX (OE-197) — To Do. Vehicle assignment duplicate-plate filter fix (OE-191) — Code Review. RCD-TECHLOG order date issue (OE-93) — Rejected by QA, needs rework. Monthly planning & retrospective ceremony (OE-250).

customfield_10020.name: Sprint 7
customfield_10020.goal:
Sprint Goal

Close out the Control Tower (Torre de Controle) foundations already in flight — KPI header, structured alert tratativa and persisted destination ETA — and open the usability layer that makes the Tower workable at real operating volume: global filters, the lane as a queryable field, expandable multi-stop trips, quick view and a standardized alert catalog. In parallel, clear a batch of client-facing fixes with direct billing, SLA and legal exposure.

Product and UX/UI

Discovery — Global filters: client, date, lane, status, alert category (OE-301). Highest priority agreed for this sprint: without filters the Tower still shows the whole history at once.
Discovery — Expand a trip row into its deliveries and pickups (OE-304), ending the flattened duplicate rows in the trips list.
Quick view popup — journey, steps, evidence and event log (OE-302).

Main Deliveries

Alert Type Catalog — alert_type table plus the 15 seed records with translated labels and the external reference code (OE-296).
Persist the Amazon lane in a dedicated queryable field instead of a tag (OE-303) — prerequisite for the lane filter and for any per-lane analysis.
Act Now — structured tratativa reasons, operator ↔ driver (OE-220) + backend cadastro and persistence (OE-279).
Control Tower KPI header — Backend (OE-273) and Frontend (OE-232).

Progress (carried over from Sprint 6)

KPI header, BE (OE-273) and FE (OE-232) — Code Review
Act Now tratativa, FE (OE-220) — Code Review · BE (OE-279) — Waiting for tasks
Persist/display destination ETA via price_detail, owned by INF (OE-203) — In Progress
Vehicle assignment duplicate-plate filter (OE-191) — Rejected by QA, needs rework ⚠️

Must Be Completed This Sprint

KPI header end to end (OE-273 + OE-232) — third sprint in flight, cannot slip again
Alert tratativa end to end (OE-220 + OE-279)
ETA persistence via price_detail (OE-203)
Lane persisted in its own field (OE-303) — unblocks the global filter work

Also In This Sprint (client-facing fixes / maintenance / tech debt)

Return-task quota showing the wrong company, with invoice price divergence (OE-221). Incidence images and PDFs not reaching the driver app (OE-299). Package-size translation breaking the vehicle allocation rule (OE-295). Boticário account rename, VD ↔ OMNI inverted (OE-294). New "H2H" operation type and Middle Mile — Especiais rename (OE-249). Child-company selector in Import for basic parent accounts (OE-198). shippify.cl typography migration from Brother 1816 to Geologica, closing the licensing exposure (OE-293). Tech support (OE-343). Trainings and ceremonies (OE-314).
